label: 小山包等高线生成
description: 在单张输入掩码区域内生成圆润的小山包，多层等高线严格一层套一层呈同心状分布，并把每层累积成**实心嵌套面**（第 i 层含所有高度 ≥ i 的格子）逐张输出——隐藏上层会露出下一层顶面而不是地面。内置形态学后处理（填孔洞、删碎块、归并空白）。要互斥的条带式退台悬崖请用 strip_cliff_generate。网格列表由引擎按 DataTree 自动逐张 fanout。
description-en: Generates smooth rounded hills within a single input mask. Contour layers are strictly nested, and every layer is accumulated into a solid nested face (level i holds every cell at elevation >= i) emitted one grid per branch, so hiding an upper layer reveals the face below instead of the ground. Includes morphological post-processing. Use strip_cliff_generate for mutually exclusive stepped cliff bands. Grid lists are handled per-item by the DataTree engine.
icon: 俯视小山包，多层实心台地由外向内层层叠高，每层边缘一圈悬崖，棕绿渐变配色，外层最浅最内层最深。扁平插画风格，简洁小图标，主色2种。

inputs.name: inputGrid
inputs.label: 输入网格
inputs.description: 单张输入掩码网格（number[][]），仅对非 0 格子生成等高线；网格列表由引擎逐张 fanout。
inputs.description-en: Single input mask grid (number[][]); contours are generated only for non-zero cells. The engine fans out a grid list one-by-one.

inputs.name: contourLevels
inputs.label: 等高线层数
inputs.description: 等高线层数，决定同心圈的数量，数值越大分层越细。
inputs.description-en: Number of contour levels; determines how many concentric rings are generated.

inputs.name: hillCount
inputs.label: 山头数量
inputs.description: 掩码区域内的山峰数量，每个山峰产生独立的同心圈等高线。
inputs.description-en: Number of hill peaks within the mask; each peak generates its own concentric contours.

inputs.name: roundness
inputs.label: 圆度
inputs.description: 等高线圆润程度，0=较方正，1=接近正圆，介于0~1之间。
inputs.description-en: Roundness of contour rings: 0=more angular, 1=near-circular. Range 0-1.

inputs.name: peakRadius
inputs.label: 山包半径
inputs.description: 每个山包的影响半径，归一化坐标（0~1），越大山包覆盖面积越宽。
inputs.description-en: Influence radius for each hill peak in normalized coords (0-1); larger = broader hill.

inputs.name: noiseAmount
inputs.label: 边缘扰动量
inputs.description: 等高线边缘的噪声扰动强度，0=完美圆形，0.2=自然边缘。
inputs.description-en: Noise perturbation on contour edges: 0=perfect circle, 0.2=natural organic edges.

inputs.name: minHoleSize
inputs.label: 最大孔洞面积
inputs.description: 后处理：面积 ≤ 此值且被单一颜色完全包围的 0 连通域将被填充。
inputs.description-en: Post-process: zero-regions with area ≤ this value enclosed by a single color will be filled.

inputs.name: minIslandSize
inputs.label: 最小岛屿面积
inputs.description: 后处理：面积 < 此值的孤立非零连通域将被删除（置0）。
inputs.description-en: Post-process: non-zero connected regions with area < this value will be removed.

inputs.name: peakPosition
inputs.label: 山头位置
inputs.description: 九宫格位置（1-9），对应键盘数字键布局：7=左上 8=上中 9=右上 4=左中 5=正中 6=右中 1=左下 2=下中 3=右下。不连接时程序每次随机产生。
inputs.description-en: Numpad position (1-9): 7=top-left 8=top-center 9=top-right 4=mid-left 5=center 6=mid-right 1=bot-left 2=bot-center 3=bot-right. If not connected, a random position is used each time.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: 随机种子
inputs.description: 随机种子，0 使用当前时间。

outputs.name: outputGrids
outputs.label: 实心层网格
outputs.description: 每层一张实心嵌套面：第 i 张含所有高度层 ≥ i 的格子（格值 = i），逐张成为独立子分支，直接接 grid2node.grid（不要再接 grid_split_by_value）。层层实心相互覆盖，隐藏上层会露出下一层顶面而不是地面。
outputs.description-en: One solid nested face per level: the i-th grid holds every cell whose elevation level is >= i (cell value = i). Each grid becomes its own child branch; wire straight into grid2node.grid (do not pass through grid_split_by_value). Because the faces are solid and stacked, hiding an upper layer reveals the face below instead of the ground.

outputs.name: outputLevels
outputs.label: 层顶高度
outputs.description: 与 outputGrids 一一对应的层顶高度（最低层 0，每上一层 +1）；必须接 grid2node.z，否则各层都压在同一平面上。
outputs.description-en: Top height per level, aligned with outputGrids (lowest layer 0, +1 per level up). Must be wired to grid2node.z, otherwise every layer collapses onto the same plane.

outputs.name: outputGrid
outputs.label: 等高线网格
outputs.description: 单张多值网格：每格写入其所属等高带层序号（1..contourLevels，外→内递增），其余为 0。用于预览，以及作 alg_region_subtract 的减数求剩余空地；分层建节点请用 outputGrids。
outputs.description-en: Single multi-value grid: each cell holds its elevation band index (1..contourLevels, outer to inner), others 0. Use it for preview and as the subtrahend of alg_region_subtract; build per-layer nodes from outputGrids instead.

outputs.name: outputNameList
outputs.label: 名称清单
outputs.description: 网格中实际出现的各层名称清单（山包层1, 山包层2, …），格式 [{id, name, type}]。
outputs.description-en: Name list [{id, name, type}] for the contour bands actually present in the grid.
